low_power_modes_summary.active_run: ICC max 15 mA at VDD = 5.5 V; XIN running.
low_power_modes_summary.clock_gating: Reducing XIN frequency reduces dynamic current proportionally.
low_power_modes_summary.no_explicit_sleep_mode: PC16550D has no formal sleep/standby register; standby is achieved by stopping XIN externally.

fields.notes: IO-Link's protocol-level power intent is a 24 V supply over the three-wire interface (L+, L-, C/Q), with the C/Q line operating in SIO (switching) or SDCI (communication) mode. Fine-grained power-domain control is a Device / SoC concern.

power_management_states.name: Standard IO
power_management_states.description: Device powered, C/Q line as a binary switching signal, no communication.

power_management_states.name: Communication
power_management_states.description: Device powered, UART communication active on the C/Q line.

fields.wakeup_mechanism: The Master applies a wake-up request on the C/Q line, switching the Device from SIO mode into SDCI communication mode. On Fallback or communication loss the Device returns to SIO.

power_rails.purpose: Device supply over the supply wire.
Push-pull driver of the C/Q signal line.

fields.io_link_power_considerations: IO-Link defines a three-wire supply: L+ (24 V), L- (ground), and the C/Q signal line. The Device draws operating current from L+/L-; the C/Q communication shares the supply ground. Detailed rails and low-power behavior are Device-implementation concerns.
